_doc: Camera monitoring policy for glados_hub (see glados_hub/cameras.py). One entry per camera. 'id' is the camera's numeric Scrypted device id (e.g. '65' — the number shown in Scrypted's device id / used in the scrypted/<id>/ObjectDetector MQTT topic; front=65, back=62). 'label' = spoken name in reports. 'announce' = auto-announce activity on the house speakers. 'classes' = classes to track/announce. 'zones' = extra hub-side whitelist of the NVR zone tags a detection must carry to count (empty = accept whatever the NVR emits; the zones drawn in the Scrypted UI still apply at the source). NOTE: package detections are tagged 'packageZone' — include that name here if you keep package announcements while using a zone whitelist. 'cooldown_s' = re-announce cooldown. 'lines' = per-class override of the spoken announcement line. This file is bind-mounted into the hub container and editable LIVE via the web UI at http://<hub>:5051/ (or edit it here — the next save/reload in the UI picks it up); no rebuild needed.
